project.title: Ride Slowly, Ride Safely
project.logline: When careful Alex refuses to match his older brother Bob's reckless speed, a minor accident teaches both siblings that safety matters more than winning.
project.purpose: Slow English learning video for beginner English learners.
project.audience: Beginner English learners, families, and children

story.idea: Alex and Bob are siblings. They go cycling in a park. Alex is careful and rides slowly. Bob challenges Alex to a race and rides very fast while Alex continues at a safe pace. Bob fails to avoid a small fallen branch, loses control, and receives mild injuries. Alex stops and helps him. Bob realizes that riding safely is more important than winning.
story.theme: Safety is more important than speed or pride.
story.moral: Ride slowly, watch the path, and never let competition override safety.

story_beats.description: The siblings begin a pleasant bicycle ride in the park.
Bob playfully challenges Alex to race to a large tree.
Alex remains careful while Bob accelerates and pressures him.
Alex notices a branch and slows; Bob notices too late and loses balance.
Bob has a mild, non-graphic injury and Alex stops to help.
Bob admits his mistake, and the siblings choose to ride safely together.
